AboutPage.title: About Tixora
AboutPage.p1: Tixora is a platform for discovering and booking tickets to concerts, sports, theater, and other live events.
AboutPage.p2: We work directly with event organizers to bring tickets online, so you can browse, book, and manage your orders in one place.

PrivacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.p1: Tixora collects the information you provide when you sign in and book tickets, such as your name, email address, and profile picture from your Google account, along with your order history.
PrivacyPage.p2: We use this information solely to process ticket orders, send booking confirmations, and provide customer support. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.
PrivacyPage.p3: If you have questions about how your data is handled, please contact our support team.

TermsPage.title: Terms & Conditions
TermsPage.p1: By purchasing tickets through Tixora, you agree to these terms. Tickets are issued subject to availability and are non-refundable and non-transferable, except where required by law or permitted by the event organizer.
TermsPage.p2: You are responsible for providing accurate buyer information at checkout. Ticket holders may be asked to present a valid ID matching the name on the order at the venue.
TermsPage.p3: Tixora acts as a ticketing platform on behalf of event organizers and is not responsible for event cancellations, rescheduling, or changes made by the organizer.
